complete_download: All 2419 used unit ballot observations, 318 county observations, state controls, native dates/status/clocks/denominator definitions, all 11 used-source receipts, full methods, original independent check receipt, exact code/tests and results reproduce offline. Selected-fact reproduction does not reverify original HTML bytes or repeat initial native extraction. Initial extraction requires the hash-pinned private originals. Original 2022/2024/2026 package remains unchanged and available.
denominators: Native historical Eligible Voters are estimated residents aged 18+, not registered voters, a fixed eligible electorate or a denominator used for demographic turnout.
endorsement: This analysis is not endorsed by the source.
geographic_interpretation: Exact county names only; old county IDs are portal ordinals, not FIPS. Named older units are not numeric IDs. No fixed people, analytical area overlay or precinct crosswalk.

independent_check.first_verifier_attempt: Stopped before proof because it expected one link per county; native blocks also contain an explicit #maincontent back-to-top link. Corrected checker requires both links and reuses the same frozen originals. No source or accounting gate changed.

selected_factual_inputs_basis: Complete aggregate election facts and source receipts, independently checked against frozen native pages; no copyrighted page code, unrelated contests or voter records.
source_attribution: North Dakota Secretary of State and county election officials
temporal_interpretation: Official historical counts and one unofficial frozen 2026 reported-count observation. 2026-minus-earlier counts are not final turnout change or individual transition estimates.
uncertainty: Counts are native observations, not modeled population estimates. Their differences do not identify individual staying home, returning participation or candidate switching; no design confidence intervals are fabricated.
